mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months indicates an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces the cost of capital for corporations, leading to higher equity valuations and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where FEDFUNDS has declined for 3 consecutive months, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 5.0% for two consecutive months, it signals a weakening labor market that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE has exceeded 5.0% for two consecutive months, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate a contraction in consumer demand, which reduces corporate revenue expectations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where both HOUST and RSAFS decline for two consecutive months, or the Rank IC for the interaction is below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of declining industrial production (INDPRO) below 100, manufacturing output contraction signals reduced corporate capacity utilization and lower near-term earnings, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where INDPRO is below 100, or the Rank IC for the INDPRO < 100 condition is below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising quarterly GDP growth rate (GDPC1) indicates expanding economic activity that boosts corporate profits and investor confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods with rising GDPC1, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year CPI inflation (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 5.0%, it signals persistent inflation that triggers aggressive monetary tightening, reducing equity valuations and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where CPIAUCSL exceeds 5.0%, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in employment (PAYEMS) and decreases in unemployment (UNRATE) indicate a tight labor market that drives wage growth and inflationary pressures, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as the Fed may accelerate rate hikes.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where PAYEMS rises and UNRATE falls for two consecutive months, or the Rank IC for the interaction is below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS > 1.5% and rising), the Federal Reserve's policy rate hikes increase discount rates for equity valuation, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where FEDFUNDS is above 1.5% and rising, or the Rank IC for the tightening cycle condition is below 0.03 over any 3-year window.
